# inish.in — Nish's Daily Reads

A daily read for a founder: AI news, product ideas, and early signals of demand — in plain words. Point first, nothing here unless there is a fact under it. Published by Nish (https://github.com/nish3451). The sources of every story remain the source of truth; each story carries a Checked fact linked to its evidence.

## How to read this site

- The root page is the current daily edition. It rolls over every day; there are no archives.
- Each story carries four parts: a summary, a Checked fact with a link to its evidence, Nish's take, and a caveat.
- The same edition ships as machine-readable feeds: /latest.json (JSON) and /feed.xml (RSS).
- /sitemap.xml lists the public surface; /robots.txt allows crawling and AI input. AI training is opted out via `ai-train=no`.

## Essential links

- Home: https://inish.in/
- Today's edition (JSON): https://inish.in/latest.json
- RSS feed: https://inish.in/feed.xml
- Public pages: https://inish.in/ (feed only; no archives, no founder pages)
